'''Titus Sypknee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You dare insult Lady Valarian?|Titus Sypknee, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TV" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Titus Sypknee worked as the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]].<ref name="SWG:TV" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a lab assistant from the [[Mos Eisley Biolab]], [[Bera Jeza]], was assassinated in a street of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Since she had ties with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], his majordomo [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the murder.<ref name="SWG:GC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Gather Clues|Tatooine}}</ref> Working with the [[Slicer/Legends|Slicer]] [[Cale Herron]], the spacer was not able to find the assassin. As Fortuna urged the spacer to solve the case, Herron suggested to blame Lady Valarian, Jabba's rival on Tatooine, for the murder. The spacer therefore visited Lady Valarian at the [[Lucky Despot]], in Mos Eisley, and accused the crime lord in the name of Jabba. Indeed, Lady Valarian was not eager to be held responsible for a murder she did not order. Valarian then ordered Titus Sypknee to get rid of the spacer. The assassin attacked the spacer but the latter managed to kill Sypknee.<ref name="SWG:TV" /> The spacer eventually forced Lady Valarian to pay reparations to Jabba the Hutt.<ref name="SWG:JC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I think it is about time someone competent took over.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="SWG:JC" />}}
[[File:TitusSypkneeEye.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Sypknee's natural [[Eye/Legends|eye]] appearance.]]
Titus Sypknee appeared as a dead [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Titus Sypknee was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This NPC was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:TV" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>

In the game, Titus Sypknee was a hostile [[W:c:swg:Elite|elite]] NPC who could only be defeated by a group of players.<ref name="SWG:TV" /> However, killing Sypknee was not required to complete the questline. In fact, if the player was killed, he/she was respawned at the nearest cloning center and received a communication from Jabba declaring that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] would take care of Titus Sypknee.<ref name="SWG:JC" />
